title: Bread Giver
description: This is a Plugin that Gives Bread to players after they die or after they kill someone, perfect for tournaments
body:
BreadPlugin is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that rewards players with bread when they engage in PvP combat. When a player kills another player, they instantly receive 5 bread. When a player dies, they are granted 5 bread upon respawning, ensuring the reward lands in their fresh inventory. This mechanic adds a playful and mythic twist to combat, encouraging both aggression and resilience.
Designed for simplicity and modularity, BreadPlugin is easy to install and extend. Whether you're running a competitive server, a lore-driven world, or just want to inject some carb-fueled chaos into your gameplay, BreadPlugin delivers. Developers can customize it further with particle effects, lore text, enchantments, or configuration options. It’s compatible with Spigot and Paper servers and built with clean event-driven architecture for reliable performance.
